description: Risk Engine configuration. Each category has a maximum point value and a set of additive rules. Points never exceed the category maximum. Edit this file to tune scoring; do not hardcode scoring in Python.

jurisdiction.name: Jurisdiction assessment incomplete
jurisdiction.explanation: Required jurisdiction facts are missing, so jurisdiction cannot yet be preliminarily assessed.

jurisdiction.name: Formal EAR jurisdiction review required
jurisdiction.explanation: The recorded facts indicate that EAR jurisdiction should be formally reviewed before further processing.

jurisdiction.name: U.S.-origin item without recorded ECCN
jurisdiction.condition: jurisdiction_status == 'POSSIBLE_EAR_JURISDICTION' and is_us_origin == true and has_eccn == false
jurisdiction.explanation: The item appears to be U.S.-origin and no ECCN or EAR classification is recorded. Classification is needed to support further review.

jurisdiction.name: Potential U.S. nexus from content or production inputs
jurisdiction.condition: jurisdiction_status == 'POSSIBLE_EAR_JURISDICTION' and (has_us_content == true or us_software_used_in_production == true or us_technology_used_in_production == true)
jurisdiction.explanation: A U.S.-origin nexus is possible through controlled content or U.S.-origin production inputs; jurisdiction and license requirements cannot be excluded.

product.name: Item recorded as controlled under an ECCN
product.explanation: The item is recorded with a controlled ECCN status, increasing the need for detailed export-control review.

product.name: Military- or defense-related product terms
product.explanation: Military- or defense-related terminology was detected in the product name or description.

product.name: No ECCN recorded for item with U.S. nexus
product.condition: has_eccn == false and (is_us_origin == true or has_us_content == true)
product.explanation: No existing ECCN was provided even though the item has a possible U.S. nexus, so product classification remains open.

product.name: Product value not recorded
product.explanation: The product value is missing, limiting valuation-based checks such as de minimis context.

destination.name: Destination subject to comprehensive U.S. embargo
destination.explanation: The ultimate destination is subject to a comprehensive U.S. embargo program and warrants immediate legal review.

destination.name: Destination on special attention list
destination.explanation: The destination country is listed in the configuration's special-attention group, which may correlate with heightened license scrutiny.

destination.name: Ultimate destination unknown
destination.explanation: The ultimate destination is unknown, so destination-based risk cannot be assessed.

end_user.name: Name match requiring manual verification
end_user.explanation: A party name matches or nearly matches a reference-list entry and manual verification is required.

end_user.name: Possible fuzzy name match
end_user.explanation: A party name is similar to a reference-list entry. Additional identity verification is warranted.

end_user.name: Ultimate end user not identified
end_user.explanation: The ultimate end user has not been identified, so end-user-based risk cannot be assessed.

end_use.name: Military-related end-use indicators
end_use.explanation: The declared end use or industry contains military- or defense-related indicators.

end_use.name: Insufficient end-use information
end_use.explanation: Declared end-use information is missing or too general to support a preliminary end-use assessment.

end_use.name: Inconsistent business activity
end_use.explanation: The declared end use or industry appears inconsistent with other recorded facts.

end_use.name: Unclear installation location
end_use.explanation: The installation location is missing or too vague to support screening or diversion analysis.

red_flags.name: Multiple high-severity red flags
red_flags.explanation: The Red Flag Engine identified red flags with a combined point value of 40 or more.

red_flags.name: Red flags requiring action
red_flags.explanation: The Red Flag Engine identified red flags with a combined point value between 20 and 39.

red_flags.name: Red flags identified
red_flags.explanation: At least one red flag was identified, though the combined point value is below 20.
